title: Matthew Fine - Buying Gray Clouds and Building Resilient Portfolios

reader_summary.source_label: From the episode notes — transcript not yet available
reader_summary.headline: In this episode, hosts Tano Santos and Michael Mauboussin speak with Matthew Fine, portfolio manager at Third Avenue Management.
reader_summary.overview: In this episode, hosts Tano Santos and Michael Mauboussin speak with Matthew Fine, portfolio manager at Third Avenue Management. Matthew reflects on lessons from early experiences like the Argentine crisis and explains how balance sheet strength and long-term thinking shape investment decisions. The conversation examines global opportunities across Europe, Japan, and commodities, along with the role of resource conversion in value creation.

key_points.text: In this episode, hosts Tano Santos and Michael Mauboussin speak with Matthew Fine, portfolio manager at Third Avenue Management.
They also discuss market structure shifts, portfolio resilience during crises.
